intent: The session-start hook now adds /.work/ to every repository's .git/info/exclude, so scratch never reaches git.

files.hooks/session-start.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0
exclude="$root/.git/info/exclude"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$exclude")"
keep_out() { grep -qx "$1" "$exclude" 2>/dev/null || echo "$1" >> "$exclude"; }
keep_out '/.work/'

test.risk: an exclude file without a trailing newline gets /.work/ glued onto its last pattern
test.body:
set -e
hook="$PWD/hooks/session-start.sh"; d=$(mktemp -d); git init -q "$d/r"
printf '*.log' > "$d/r/.git/info/exclude"
(cd "$d/r" && bash "$hook")
mkdir -p "$d/r/.work"; touch "$d/r/.work/x" "$d/r/a.log"
[ -z "$(git -C "$d/r" status --porcelain)" ] || { echo "FAIL: status: $(git -C "$d/r" status --porcelain)"; exit 1; }
